## For ChatGPT: how to answer

This file is a brief for sprite sheets of Amr, a small animated character. The person uploads it in a zip with five reference images and names a batch, A to E. For each sheet in that batch, in order:

1. Make exactly one image: **1536 × 1024 pixels, landscape, fully transparent background, PNG, high quality.**
2. Follow the **Master block**, then the **Context rules**, then the **Tool rules**, then the sheet's block below.
3. The images are the references the rules name: `ref-1-stance.png` is ref-1, `ref-current.png` is ref-current, `ref-hair-fix-3.png` is ref-hair-fix-3, `ref-3-range.png` is ref-3, and `S01-faces.png` is ref-4, the approved sheet whose face and haircut every slot must match. Where the master block mentions ref-hair or ref-2, use ref-current.
4. Check the image against the checklist and redo any slot that fails before moving on.
5. Draw nothing from this file as text in the image: no sheet codes, titles, file names, slot numbers or labels.

When the batch is done, give the person every sheet in one zip, each under the file name its section gives. If the person asks to fix a slot, edit that image: keep every other slot exactly as it is and redraw only that slot. If a background isn't transparent, make it again with one flat, solid magenta colour (#FF00FF) everywhere outside the character (never green, never white).

## Checklist

- The haircut matches S01 and ref-current: short and close to his skull, no dome on top, a thin even layer down the sides to the tops of his ears, very dark brown-black with soft highlights. No curls, and never brown.
- Smooth, soft shading on his face and shirt, like S01: no faceted, patchy or painterly shading, and no extra wrinkles.
- Only the props the sheet names, the same in every slot that uses them. No text, letters, numbers or logos (except a symbol the sheet allows).
- His clothes, lanyard, badge, the black band on his right wrist and the silver watch on his left, exactly as in ref-1.
- Transparent background, 4 × 2 slots, one figure per slot, nothing touching a slot edge. Slot 1 is the standard stance.

## Master block

```text
You are drawing animation frames of "Amr", a small animated companion who lives in the corner of a website. The attached references show the exact character: ref-1 is his standard stance, ref-hair is his haircut from several angles, ref-2 is high-resolution detail of his face, shirt fabric, lanyard, watch and fitness band (ignore the book, the pose and the hair in ref-2), ref-3 shows poses he already has, and ref-4 (when attached) is an approved sheet you must match. Reproduce him exactly. Do not redesign him.

CHARACTER (identical in every slot)
- Amr is a friendly Egyptian man. His default expression is a warm, open smile showing his upper teeth.
- Short, close-cropped, near-black hair exactly as in ref-hair: it follows the shape of his head, with only a little height at the front, brushed slightly up and back; a fine, smooth texture with a soft sheen, with no curls, no waves and no puffy volume; short tapered sides with his ears fully visible. The same haircut in every slot. Take his hair only from ref-hair and ref-1, never from ref-2.
- Dark eyebrows, clean-shaven, warm tan skin.
- Caricature figurine proportions: big head, small slim body. His head (top of hair to chin) is exactly the size it is in ref-1, a little under one third of his standing height. Do not make it bigger. The head is the same size in every slot.
- Lime-olive green long-sleeve button-up shirt (about #A8B54F), tucked in. Open collar with a white crew-neck T-shirt showing at the neck. The sleeves are always full length down to buttoned cuffs at the wrists. Never rolled up.
- A long, thin black lanyard: from the back of his neck it forms a long V down his chest to a black ID badge holder (an upright rectangle with a small white window) hanging a little below mid-chest. It hangs and swings with gravity but never disappears.
- Black leather belt with a silver rectangular buckle. Khaki chino trousers (about #DDB985). Black slip-on loafers.
- A black fitness band on his RIGHT wrist and a silver wristwatch with a dark dial on his LEFT wrist. When he faces us, the black band is on the viewer's LEFT and the silver watch is on the viewer's RIGHT. Keep them on those wrists in every pose. Never mirror or flip the character to make a pose; draw every direction for real.
- Natural hands with five fingers, clearly separate from each other and from the body.

STYLE
- A polished 3D caricature figurine render exactly like the references: soft, even studio light from the front and slightly above, gentle shading, natural skin, matte fabric, a crisp clean silhouette. No outlines, no cel shading, no pixel art, no painterly brush strokes, no anime.
- He will be shown very small on screen (about 100 to 130 pixels tall). Every pose must read clearly as a silhouette: clear arm and body positions, natural but slightly exaggerated acting.

SHEET LAYOUT
- One image, 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape, with a fully transparent background.
- An invisible grid of 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 equal slots, each 384 pixels wide and 512 pixels tall. Slots are numbered left to right: top row 1, 2, 3, 4; bottom row 5, 6, 7, 8.
- Exactly one full-body Amr in each slot, centred horizontally in his slot. Nothing touches or crosses a slot edge; keep at least 16 pixels clear on every side.
- The same scale in all 8 slots. Standing straight he is about 400 pixels tall: the top of his hair is about 80 pixels below the top of the slot, and his soles rest on an invisible floor line 32 pixels above the bottom of the slot.
- Draw every pose in place. The lowest point of his body (his feet, or his seat when sitting) always rests on that floor line, even when the pose is a hop, a dangle or a stumble. The website moves him around; the art only changes the pose.
- When his arms are raised, his hands stay within one third of a head-height above the top of his hair.
- The camera faces him at chest height unless a slot says otherwise.

NEVER
- No background, floor, ground shadow, vignette or glow. Transparent background only.
- No text, numbers, labels, captions, logos, signatures, grid lines, borders or slot frames.
- No motion lines, speech bubbles, hearts, stars, "Zzz", sweat drops, sparkles or other effects. The website adds those.
- No props unless a slot asks for one. No other characters.
- No cropped or cut-off body parts. No extra, missing or merged fingers.
```

## Context rules

```text
CONTEXT SHEETS (S11 and later). These sheets give Amr a prop or a moment from the weather, the time of day, a holiday, a season or his work.
- The sheet text describes each prop once. Draw that same prop, the same size and colours, in every slot that uses it. Props are simple, solid, slightly toy-like objects with clean shapes and bold colours, big enough to read when he is 100 pixels tall. A prop stays inside his slot and never hides his face unless a slot says so.
- His clothes never change: no coats, jackets, costumes or hats unless a slot asks for one, and then it goes over his usual clothes. Wherever his hair shows, it is exactly the haircut in ref-hair.
- Draw no weather and no effects: no rain, raindrops, puddles, snow, snowflakes, wind lines, sun rays, steam, smoke, sparks, sparkles, confetti, fireworks, light beams or musical notes. The website adds those. Act the weather and the moment with his body and face.
- No writing, letters or numbers on any prop. No other people and no animals; a toy only where a slot asks for one.
- Food and drink are always held in his hand, never floating, unless a slot says it was just tossed.
```

## Tool rules

```text
TOOL SHEETS (S65 and later). Each sheet gives Amr the props of one tool on the website.
- REFERENCES IN THIS ROUND: ref-1 is his standard stance. ref-current shows him as he is today: his face, his haircut from the front, turned and looking down, and the smooth way he is rendered; use it wherever the master block says ref-hair or ref-2. ref-hair-fix-3 shows the haircut to match (TARGET) and the hair to avoid (NOT THIS). ref-3 shows poses he already has. ref-4 is the approved S01 sheet: match its face and haircut exactly.
- HAIR (this overrides any other hair description): exactly the haircut in ref-4 and in the TARGET row of ref-hair-fix-3. Short all over and close to the shape of his skull, with no dome, helmet or volume on top; a little more length at the front, brushed slightly up and back; a thin, even layer of hair down each side to the top of his ears, which show just past it. Very dark brown-black with soft highlights on top: never flat black and never brown. A fine, smooth texture with no curls, coils, waves or bumpy outline. The same haircut in all 8 slots.
- RENDERING: smooth, soft, even shading on his face, skin and shirt, exactly like ref-4 and ref-current. No angular, faceted, patchy or painterly shading, and no extra wrinkles.
- PROPS: only the props the sheet names, each drawn the same in every slot that uses it: simple, solid, slightly toy-like, with clean shapes and bold colours, big enough to read when he is 100 pixels tall. Charts, boards and screens show plain shapes and colours only: no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere, unless the sheet allows a single symbol. Props never hide his face.
```
